notes: I removed the "drop first char if tab present" rule: E4 shows tabs are simply shifted by +8 like every other character (`ab\tcd`→`ij\x11kl`, `\tabc`→`\x11ijk`, etc.). The lone `tab\there` anomaly (missing leading `|`) is inconsistent with the otherwise uniform +8 rule, so I treat it as a quirk rather than a mechanism.
